conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Mark with the IRS Tax Refund Department. I'm calling to inform you about an unclaimed tax refund linked to your recent self-employment filings. Can I confirm your identity to proceed?
Uh, hi. I drive for rideshare and do some food deliveries, is this about that? I just did my taxes last month.

Yes, exactly. Because you reported gig income, our system flagged you for a government-issued stimulus refund, but before disbursal, the IRS needs to verify your identity for security reasons. Have you received any similar notifications?
No, I didn't get anything else. How much is the refund?

Based on your records, you are eligible for a refund of $1,842.76. However, IRS protocol requires a verification fee of $128, which is fully refundable with your payout. May I please confirm your mailing address and social security number to proceed?
Uh, why do I need to pay a verification fee? That doesn't sound normal.

It's a standard federal procedure for self-employed filings, especially with potential ID discrepancies. If you don't complete the verification, your refund application will be canceled and you may be flagged for an audit. Can you confirm your address and SSN so we can avoid any issues?
Okay, my address is 221 Maple Street, and my SSN is 412-33-9876. But I'm still not sure about this fee.
Thank you. I see your refund is pending, but if the payment isn't processed today, your file could be referred for further review, leading to possible penalties or withholding of future refunds.
What kind of penalties? I can't afford to get in trouble.
Non-compliance can result in up to $500 in fines, plus possible legal action. I strongly recommend completing the verification payment now to secure your refund and avoid complications.
Okay, I don't want any trouble. How do I pay the $128?

For your convenience, you can pay using a prepaid Visa or Mastercard gift card. Please purchase the card at your nearest store and keep the receipt. When you have the card, call me back with the numbers. I'll stay on the line if you'd like.
I have some money on my debit card. Can I just give you that?

Unfortunately, our system only processes prepaid gift cards for this type of transaction. This is to prevent unauthorized withdrawals and protect your banking information. Please let me know when you're ready.
Alright, I can go to the store, but I need to know this is real. How do I know you're with the IRS?

I understand your concern, but failure to pay today will trigger an automatic hold and possible investigation. The IRS doesn't make exceptions. Please complete the purchase and provide the card details to finalize your refund.
Okay, I'll go get the card. Should I call back when I have it?
Yes, but I recommend you stay on the line so we can process this faster. Once you have the prepaid Visa or Mastercard, read me the 16-digit code, expiration, and security code from the back.
I'm heading to the store right now. It's just down the block.
Good. Please hurry, as your refund is time sensitive. If it's not verified today, legal actions may begin and funds will be seized. I'll wait on the line.
Okay, I got a $150 Visa gift card. What do you need?
Perfect. Please read me the 16-digit card number, expiration date, and the three digits from the back.
The card number is 4455 7788 9900 1234, expiration 11/29, and the code on the back is 321.
Thank you. I am submitting your verification now. Please stay on the line while I process the payment.
Okay, how long does it take? Will I get my refund right away?
Processing will take a few moments. You should receive an email confirmation within the hour. If you do not comply with further instructions, your refund and any future tax credits will be blocked.
Wait, further instructions? What else do I need to do?

There's an additional step for federal clearance: a secondary fee of $79 may be required. I'll inform you if that's the case. Ignoring these steps risks IRS penalties and a permanent hold on your account.
I really need that refund. Please just tell me what to do if you need anything else.
